name: bifrost-plugin
description: Bifrost MCP gateway plugin for Claude Code and Claude Desktop: skill discovery, agent-driven memory, one-command onboarding, signed admin policy, and OAuth 2.1 for Desktop.

gateway_url.title: Bifrost gateway URL
gateway_url.description: Your gateway's MCP endpoint, including the /mcp path. Keep the default unless your operator gave you a different gateway.

virtual_key.title: Virtual key (optional)
virtual_key.description: Get yours at https://bifrost.culture4.life/ — sign in with your company account and the page shows your key with a copy button. First visit creates it, later visits show the same one. Paste it here.

oauth_client_id.title: OAuth client ID (optional)
oauth_client_id.description: Only needed when signing in with your company account and your identity provider does not allow Claude to register itself. Ask your gateway operator for the client ID to paste here.
